marketing.metaTitle: KeduckAI - AI Agent content creation and publishing
marketing.metaDescription: KeduckAI starts from content Agents for Xiaohongshu image posts, Toutiao, Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, CSDN, and more. Enter one topic to generate titles, body copy, image prompts, visual plans, publishing preview, account selection, and publishing workflows.
marketing.jsonLdDescription: An AI Agent creation and publishing platform for Xiaohongshu image posts, Toutiao, Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, CSDN, and more. Supports one-prompt content planning, image prompts, AI image generation, publishing preview, account selection, and automated publishing.
marketing.downloadPageSubtitle: Choose the build that matches your device and start creating and publishing quickly.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Choose a Xiaohongshu, Toutiao, Zhihu, WeChat Official Account, or CSDN Agent, enter a topic, and generate titles, body copy, image prompts, and visual plans that flow into editing, preview, account selection, and publishing.
marketing.spotlightsTitle: An Agent workflow from topic to publish
marketing.spotlightsSubtitle: Designed around platform-specific content formats: choose an Agent, generate image posts or articles, then move into preview, account selection, and publishing.
marketing.spotlightChatDesc: Xiaohongshu image posts, Toutiao, Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, and CSDN are split into dedicated Agents so users can start from the target platform instead of prompt structure.
marketing.spotlightPersonaDesc: Enter a topic or requirement and AI breaks it into titles, body direction, content structure, and platform-specific expression points.
marketing.spotlightTopicsDesc: For visual post scenarios like Xiaohongshu, generate titles, copy, and editable image prompts for each panel, then refine or regenerate as needed.
marketing.spotlightImageDesc: Generate images by ratio, style, and count. Regeneration keeps previous versions so you can compare old and new images and prompts.
marketing.spotlightPublishDesc: After generation, enter platform-specific publishing previews. Xiaohongshu image posts support carousel images, title, body copy, and account filtering.
marketing.spotlightAutomationDesc: Automated publishing, asset management, and publishing records help turn ad hoc creation into a trackable daily content workflow.
marketing.audienceTitle: Who is it for? People who need platform-ready content faster
marketing.audienceSubtitle: KeduckAI is built for teams and creators who want to start from "what should I publish?" instead of complex prompt engineering.
marketing.audience1Desc: Generate image-post topics, titles, copy, and image prompts from one topic, then edit, regenerate, and publish.
marketing.audience2Desc: Quickly create content structures for Toutiao, Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, CSDN, and more, reducing cross-platform rewriting work.
marketing.audience3Desc: Turn campaigns, product selling points, and user needs into platform-ready content plans, then publish through account selection and preview.
marketing.audience4Desc: Skip prompt setup and use Agents to turn ideas into image posts or articles while keeping assets and publishing records.
marketing.choosePoint1Desc: Agent selection, content generation, image generation, editing preview, and publishing account selection live in one workflow.
marketing.choosePoint2Desc: Prompts, images, and publish results remain adjustable. Regeneration keeps history, while assets and publishing records accumulate over time.
marketing.testimonialsSubtitle: Feedback from content operators, brand teams, and creators
marketing.testimonial1Quote: For Xiaohongshu posts, we no longer write image prompts one by one. One topic gives us a full post plan that we can edit and regenerate.
marketing.testimonial2Quote: We used to adapt the same topic for multiple platforms manually. Now we choose an Agent first, and the structure is much easier to edit and preview.
marketing.testimonial3Quote: Image regeneration keeps previous versions, which makes comparison useful. Before publishing, we can confirm accounts and preview platform-specific output.
marketing.guidePageLead: You can start from any step, but we recommend defining personas and topic logic first before publishing for more stable quality and efficiency.
marketing.guideStep1Title: Sign in and open Creation Center
marketing.guideStep1Desc: Open Creation Center from the sidebar and start a new chat. Clearly describe your goal, platform, and tone requirements in one go.
marketing.guideStep2Title: Complete personas and topic selection in chat
marketing.guideStep2Desc: First create creation-focused personas (tone, audience, expression boundaries), then expand ideas based on platform trends to get a batch of directly writable topic suggestions.
marketing.guideStep3Desc: Specify target platform, length, and structure to generate content. For visuals, choose AI generation, web search, or media library; the system inserts suitable images automatically.
marketing.guideStep4Desc: Method 1: keep chatting after generation and tell AI which account to publish to directly. Method 2: open the document for edits first, then publish manually to each platform. For scheduled automation, fill in "Create Scheduled Plan" and let the system create and publish on time automatically.
marketing.guideStep5Desc: Store reusable assets and finalized drafts in the library to make team sharing and review easier.
marketing.guideStep6Desc: Open "Buy Plan" from the personal menu, then choose monthly or yearly billing and complete payment.
marketing.pricingPageLead: Credits power chat creation and scheduled-plan automation (including cadence-based generation and publish steps). Final amounts are shown in-app.
marketing.pricingFootnote: Prices and promotions may change; see the in-app purchase dialog for current amounts and invoices.
marketing.faqPageLead: Common questions about personas, trend expansion, chat publishing, manual publishing, automation plans, and platform support.
marketing.faq1Q: Do I need to log in before using it?
marketing.faq1A: Core creation and publishing features require login. You can browse the website first, then register or log in inside the app.
marketing.faq2A: Steps such as chat generation, visual generation, tool calls, and scheduled-plan execution consume credits according to rules. Refer to in-app details for specifics.
marketing.faq3A: Currently supports content formats and structures for Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN. Exact capabilities and account binding rules are shown in-app.
marketing.faq4A: Please download and access the product through official channels. For sensitive content, follow your organization's compliance requirements and back up important assets and final drafts regularly.
marketing.faq5Q: What publishing options are available, and how should I choose?
marketing.faq5A: There are three options: 1) Chat publishing: continue chatting after generation and issue commands to publish to target accounts. 2) Manual publishing: edit in document mode first, then manually choose platform and account. 3) Auto-publishing: fill in a scheduled plan and the system creates and publishes automatically on schedule. Use chat publishing for temporary trends, manual publishing for polished drafts, and auto-publishing for stable recurring columns.
